 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VINIT KUMAR MATHUR Order 16/04/2024 Since, the issue involved in all the writ petitions is identical, therefore, they are being decided by this common order.
For convenience, the facts of Writ Petition No.17859/2023 are taken into consideration for disposal of these writ petitions.
[2024:RJ-JD:16485] (4 of 6) [CW-17859/2023] Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The present writ petition has been filed for following reliefs:-
"i) That by an appropriate writ, order or direction may kindly be issued and the respondents may kindly be restrained to raise any transmission tower or line from/
over the land of the petitioner until the acquisition is not made under a valid notification or the process of law, the respondent may also directed for determining the compensation against the use of land under the provision of land acquisition Act,
2013.

ii) That by an appropriate writ, order and direction may kindly be issued and respondents may restrict to interference in the right of the petitioners over the land in question as mentioned in annexure-3 of the writ petition.
iii) That by an appropriate writ, order and direction may kindly be issued and the respondents may kindly be prohibited to construct the transmission tower/line upon the land of petitioners without any acquisition of the land and determine of the compensation.
Pukh Singh vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:16485) on 16 April, 2024

4 iv)

That by an appropriate writ, order and direction may kindly be issued and order/
communication dated 16.10.2023 (Annex.11) and notice dated 05.07.2023,
06.97.2023 and 21.09.2023 (Annex.4) may kindly be quashed and set aside".

Briefly noted facts of the case are that a Project for 765 KV double circuit Power Transmission,
connecting Beawar and Fatehgarh-3, is currently underway and is traversing through Jodhpur.
The Government of India has chosen Sterlite Grid Limited as the implementing agency for the above project.
This transmission line passes directly through the land owned by the petitioners yet no compensation has been determined for utilization of the land of the petitioners for the said project.
Hence, these writ petitions have been preferred.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the land of the petitioners which are located in Luni Tehsil of Jodhpur are [2024:RJ-JD:16485] (5 of 6) [CW-17859/2023] being utilized for the purpose of installation of power tower without taking any recourse provided under law and without paying them suitable compensation as per the prevalent law.
Learned counsel further submits that without determining the extent of compensation to be paid to the petitioners, erection of tower and lying down of electric line work is being undertaken.
He, therefore, prays that the land of the petitioners may be utilized after determination and payment of compensation for erection of tower and raising transmission lines from the petitioners land.
Mr. Rajesh Panwar, Senior Advocate cum Additional Advocate General and Mr. M.S.Singhvi,
learned
Senior Counsel

submit that the authorized authority i.e. District Collector, Jodhpur/ Sub Divisional Officer, Luni will determine the compensation to be paid to the petitioners and after determination of the same, the amount so determined by the authority concerned will be paid to the petitioners.

Learned Additional Advocate General submits that it is a Project of National importance, therefore, the land of the petitioners may be allowed to be utilized and in a time bound manner, determination of compensation will be made by the respondents.
Thereafter, the amount of compensation will also be paid to the petitioners.
The submission made by learned counsel for the respondents is gracefully accepted by the counsel for the petitioners.
He submits that determination of the compensation and payment of the same may be made by the authority concerned in a shortest time.

Considering the submissions made, the present writ petitions are disposed of with a direction to the District Collector, Jodhpur/ [2024:RJ-JD:16485] (6 of 6) [CW-17859/2023] Sub Divisional Officer,
Luni to determine compensation of the petitioners' land which is being utilized for erection of transmission line within a period of two weeks after giving reasonable opportunity of hearing to all the concerned parties.

Determination of amount of compensation shall be done by the competent authority in accordance with the guidelines dated 15.10.2015 (Annex.6 & 7) issued by the Ministry of Power, Government of India including payment of compensation for erection of Tower and right of way, in addition to other points.
